description: JUnit test class for CommandConsumerFactoryImpl, verifying behavior of command consumer creation, connection handling, re-creation upon failure, and lifecycle management in the Eclipse Hono client implementation.

classes.name: CommandConsumerFactoryImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for CommandConsumerFactoryImpl, testing command consumer creation, lifecycle, error handling, and connection management behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures, mocks connections and receivers, and prepares the CommandConsumerFactoryImpl instance.

methods.name: testCreateCommandConsumerFailsIfPeerRejectsLink
methods.description: Tests failure scenario when the peer rejects link creation.

methods.name: testCreateCommandConsumerSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies successful creation of command consumer for tenant and device ID.

methods.name: testCreateCommandConsumerSetsRemoteCloseHandler
methods.description: Ensures the close handler is invoked when the remote peer closes the link for a device-specific consumer.

methods.name: testCreateCommandConsumerWithGatewaySetsRemoteCloseHandler
methods.description: Ensures the close handler is invoked when the peer closes the link for gateway-specific consumers.

methods.name: testLocalCloseRemovesCommandConsumerFromCache
methods.description: Checks that closing a consumer locally removes it from cache, cancels timers, and re-establishes a new link on re-creation.

methods.name: testConsumerIsRecreatedOnConnectionFailure
methods.description: Verifies that consumer links are re-established when the connection to the peer is lost.

methods.name: testLivenessCheckLocksRecreationAttempt
methods.description: Ensures that multiple liveness checks do not trigger concurrent re-creation attempts for the same consumer.
